front.title: COSE and JOSE Registrations for ShangMi (SM) Cryptographic Algorithms

abstract.t: This document registers code points for the use of the Chinese ShangMi (SM) cryptographic algorithms with CBOR Object Signing and Encryption (COSE) and JSON Object Signing and Encryption (JOSE): the elliptic curve curveSM2, the SM2 digital signature algorithm with the SM3 hash function, SM2 public key encryption for content key transport, HMAC-SM3, and the SM4 block cipher in GCM mode. For COSE, it additionally registers the SM3 hash function, key derivation with HKDF-SM3, and SM4 in CCM mode.
